question: How many players were honoured with the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**12.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna** Award are given every year **to recognize and reward excellence in sports.**
 
• **12 players** were honored with the **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award in 2021.**
 
• The full list of sportspersons to win the award are:
 
 
• **Neeraj Chopra for Athletics**
 
• **Ravi Kumar for Wrestling**
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain for Boxing**
 
• **Sreejesh P.R for Hockey**
 
• **Avani Lekhara for Para Shooting**
 
• **Sumit Antil for Para-Athletics**
 
• **Pramod Bhagat for Para-Badminton**
 
• **Krishna Nagar for Para-Badminton**
 
• **Manish Narwal for Para-Shooting**
 
• **Mithali Raj for Cricket**
 
• **Sunil Chhetri for Football**
 
• **Manpreet Singh for Hockey**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna

 
 
• ​The **Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award **is **formerly known as the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award** in Sports and Games.
 
• It is the highest sporting honor in India.
 
• It is awarded annually by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
• The** first recipient **of the award was **Chess Grandmaster Viswanathan Anand.**
 
• The award comprises **a medallion, a certificate, and a cash prize of ₹25 lakh.**
